results.name: INTJ — The Strategist
results.body: You live in the future — running scenarios, seeing outcomes others reach months later. You trust logic and a small circle, and you'd rather be right and alone than agreeable and wrong.
results.youGrowWhen: you let people in and trust feelings, not just plans.

results.name: INTP — The Thinker
results.body: You take everything apart to see how it truly works. Rules mean little to you unless they make sense, and a good problem can absorb you for hours. Your mind is your favorite place to be.
results.youGrowWhen: you turn one idea into something real instead of a hundred that stay in your head.

results.name: ENTJ — The Commander
results.body: You see the goal and the fastest path to it, and you can't help but organize the people around you toward it. Inefficiency frustrates you because you know things could be better.
results.youGrowWhen: you slow down enough to hear the people behind the plan.

results.name: ENTP — The Visionary
results.tagline: The one who asks 'but why not?'
results.body: You spark ideas and love a good debate — not to win, but to see the world crack open a little. Boredom is your enemy; possibility is your fuel.
results.youGrowWhen: you finish the exciting thing before the next shiny idea arrives.

results.name: INFJ — The Insightful
results.body: You feel what others hide and carry a quiet idealism most never notice. Deeply private, you give a lot — sometimes more than you have. Few people ever fully know you, and that's by design.
results.youGrowWhen: you protect your energy before you burn out for everyone else.

results.name: INFP — The Dreamer
results.body: Meaning matters more to you than money or status. You have a rich inner world and a strong sense of who you are, even when you don't say it out loud. When something touches your values, you feel it all the way through.
results.youGrowWhen: you turn your ideals into small, real actions.

results.name: ENFJ — The Mentor
results.tagline: You bring out the best in people.
results.body: You read people effortlessly and can't help lifting them up. Rooms feel warmer when you're in them. But the same radar that reads everyone can make you forget to check in on yourself.
results.atYourBest: inspiring, warm, a natural leader of hearts.
results.youGrowWhen: you set boundaries as generously as you give.

results.name: ENFP — The Spark
results.body: You light up around people and ideas, jumping between passions with real enthusiasm. Life feels like an open field of what-ifs. Underneath the energy is a search for something — and someone — that truly means it.
results.atYourBest: enthusiastic, creative, impossible not to like.
results.youGrowWhen: you channel the spark into a few things you see all the way through.

results.name: ISTJ — The Backbone
results.body: You do what you say, quietly and well. Order and reliability aren't boring to you — they're how you show you care. When everyone else flakes, you're still standing there, keeping the promise.
results.atYourBest: dependable, grounded, honest to the core.
results.youGrowWhen: you stay open to new ways, not just the proven ones.

results.name: ISFJ — The Protector
results.body: You notice the small things — who's tired, what's missing, what needs doing — and you handle it without asking for credit. Your loyalty runs deep. People feel safe with you, even if they can't say why.
results.atYourBest: caring, attentive, steady as a rock.
results.youGrowWhen: you speak your own needs out loud.

results.name: ESTJ — The Director
results.body: You bring structure to chaos and people naturally fall in line because you get results. You value honesty and hard work, and you have little patience for excuses.
results.youGrowWhen: you lead with empathy as well as standards.

results.name: ESFJ — The Harmonizer
results.body: You keep people connected and cared for, and you feel it deeply when the vibe is off. Being needed feels good — but you deserve to be chosen, not just relied on.
results.youGrowWhen: you value your own worth beyond others' approval.

results.name: ISTP — The Maker
results.body: You figure things out by doing, not talking. Cool under pressure, you solve what others panic over. You need freedom and space — and you say more with actions than words.
results.youGrowWhen: you let people closer to the world inside you.

results.name: ISFP — The Artist
results.body: Gentle and observant, you live in the present and notice beauty others walk past. You don't need the spotlight; you just need to be true to yourself. Beneath the quiet is a strong, private core.
results.youGrowWhen: you back your talent with a bit of structure and self-belief.

results.name: ESTP — The Daredevil
results.body: You're bold, fast, and fully alive in the moment. Risk doesn't scare you — stagnation does. People are drawn to your energy and your nerve.
results.youGrowWhen: you pause long enough to weigh the long game.

results.name: ESFP — The Performer
results.tagline: You turn life into a show.
results.body: Warm, spontaneous, and generous, you make ordinary moments feel like an event. You love people and they love you back. Behind the fun is someone who feels things far more deeply than they let on.
results.youGrowWhen: you pair the spark with steady, long-term follow-through.
